## Hypotheses

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="60%"}
- Does not belong in a hypothesis EVER! 
  - "and" clearly indicates two parts of a hypothesis or two hypotheses

- Requirements
  - Can be tested
  - Does not include "and"
  - Wording must match your analysis(es) --> affect = causal language
  - Directionality 
:::
